reauth_confirm.description: The API key is no longer accepted. Enter a new one.

abort.already_configured: This Yesplan installation is already added.

init.title: Yesplan options
init.description: Ticket sales: enter the names (keywords) of the custom data fields in Yesplan. The capacity field is required, the others are optional. Custom fields: add as many extra fields as you like (maximum 20); they are added to every event, labelled with the name Yesplan gives them. Leave all empty to turn it off.{invalid}

error.invalid_fields: Yesplan rejects one or more of these fields. Check the names (keywords); see below which ones.
